title: Orthodox monasteries and hermitages of Russia, Ukraine and Belarus with founding and closing years (Harvard CGA ArcGIS layer)
licence: none stated on the ArcGIS layer — private pack
describe: Monasteries and hermitages (pustyni) with the founding year the dataset gives and, where it gives one, the year of closure (e.g. the 1764 secularisation); without a closing year the end is left open. Years given as a century midpoint (1350, 1450…) are shown as that whole century; records without a founding year are left out.
datingLabel: founding (and closing) year in the dataset
